newsitem.title: CHINA: China to draft public tender law.
newsitem.headline: China to draft public tender law.

text.p: China will start drafting a law on public tenders to standardise its bidding procedures and promote fair competition, the China Chemical Industry News said on Tuesday.
The National People's Congress, or the parliament, had entrusted the State Planning Commission to start drafting the law, it said.
It gave no indication of when the draft might be ready.
The law, which would cover all public tenders, would provide detailed regulations on invitations and bidding procedures as well as the management and supervision of tenders.
It also would cover the rights, duties and legal responsibility of participants, it said.
The law would be in accordance with guidelines of the World Trade Organisation, and further promote economic exchange and cooperation with other countries, the newspaper said.

China has been seeking to join the World Trade Organisation but some Western countries, particularly the United States, have insisted that it open its domestic market to foreign companies and make its trade regulations more transparent.
